purpose: Search for a new high-mobilization opportunity after closing generic overseas field service; test AI-built-app production-readiness review as a minimum-service-unit mismatch rather than a consulting business.

candidate.title: Human production-readiness micro-review for AI/vibe-coded applications
reality_change: AI coding tools have lowered the cost of producing working software and expanded the builder population beyond traditional software teams.
Chinese AI-coding communities publicly show solo/nontraditional builders shipping real mini-programs and applications, including projects with thousands to tens of thousands of users.

Security/engineering research and practitioner guidance repeatedly show that AI-built applications can be functionally working while still carrying security, architecture, data, deployment and maintainability risk.

observed_actors: TRAE community solo builders shipping live mini-programs/apps
nontechnical/product/operations builders using AI coding to publish real tools
small teams moving prototypes toward real users, payments, data and public deployment
observed_pressure: Public Chinese engineering content repeatedly describes the 'works but not safe/confident to ship' problem.
One TRAE case publicly reports 30k registered users from a vibe-coded mini-program, proving AI-built software is reaching real users rather than remaining demo-only.
Global providers already sell fixed-price human production-readiness/security audits specifically for AI-built apps, proving some buyers pay for judgment after AI has produced working code.

observed_resources: Large pool of experienced software engineers accessible through Chinese flexible-work platforms.
Platforms such as 之马工场 explicitly recruit technical workers who want tasks allocated without business-development/price-negotiation burden.
General freelance developer platforms provide additional replaceable engineering supply.

observed_existing_routes: Claude/Cursor and domestic AI coding products provide automated code review.
Vibe CSA and similar tools automate AI-oriented code/security analysis.
Public checklists help builders self-audit before launch.
Traditional security/code-audit consultancies provide deeper reviews.
Global niche providers now productize human AI-app production-readiness audits at fixed prices.
General freelance platforms can source developers but do not by themselves prove a standardized review product.
global_value_capture_evidence: ProductionReady.co publishes a fixed USD 1,500–3,000 Vibe Code Audit with structured findings and remediation roadmap.
NexAI Advisors publishes a USD 500 discovery/review unit and USD 1,500–2,500 production-readiness audit.
Upwork sellers publish AI-built-app reviews as low as about USD 250.
Other providers publish human-run reviews from hundreds to several thousand USD.

minimum_service_unit_mismatch.incumbent_large_unit: Traditional security audit / consulting engagement / rebuild project / full outsourced development.
minimum_service_unit_mismatch.emerging_small_unit: 60–120 minute or tightly bounded senior-engineer judgment + automated evidence pack + severity-ranked report + go/no-go/remediation priority.
minimum_service_unit_mismatch.economic_tension: Many solo AI-built apps are early and low-revenue, so full formal audit economics can exceed the value of the project; pure AI self-review lacks independent human judgment.
minimum_service_unit_mismatch.exact_gap_status: HYPOTHESIS / CHINA PAYER NOT YET PROVEN

candidate.narrowed_missing_edge_hypothesis: There may be a China-market gap for a low-minimum-service-unit, fixed-scope human production-readiness review that sits between automated AI self-review and expensive consulting/security engagements. The channel would standardize intake/evidence, route each project to a qualified senior reviewer, enforce a common acceptance/report schema, and settle per review without requiring the operator to perform the review.

rooter_execution_map.demand_actor: AI/vibe-coded app builder before public launch, payment integration, customer handoff or material traffic
rooter_execution_map.supply_actor: experienced software/security/architecture engineer willing to monetize spare judgment capacity
rooter_execution_map.partial_flow: builders already use AI review/checklists or ask general developers; global agencies already sell human reviews; engineers already participate in flexible work
rooter_execution_map.missing_edge: UNPROVEN in China: a trusted fixed-scope small review unit with standard evidence/acceptance and reviewer substitution
rooter_execution_map.executor: qualified senior engineer/reviewer; specialist escalation only when needed
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: standard report covering security, auth/data, architecture, deployment, testing/rollback and prioritized severity; evidence attached; optional short debrief
rooter_execution_map.operator_role: define task schema, intake, evidence automation, reviewer graph, routing, QA, acceptance, settlement and reviewer performance history
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not personally review every repository; do not become the implementation contractor; do not represent the review as formal certification/penetration test when it is not
rooter_execution_map.exit_path: standard intake + evidence packet + reviewer specialization/routing + report schema + delegated QA

reachability.current_demand_side: C / online-public but not bound to Xuzhou/Jiangsu named payer
reachability.current_supply_side: B/C / online supply is abundant but not yet bound to one Jiangsu reviewer

mobilization.explanation: The structure has strong resource abundance, easy digital execution and global payment evidence. It remains LOW under the hard gate because China payer truth and a non-founder demand pump are unproven; self-propulsion is only 1.

strongest_counterevidence: Automated AI review quality is improving rapidly and may compress willingness to pay for shallow human review.
Global human audit providers are proliferating, so the model itself is not novel.
General freelance platforms can source senior developers directly.
Formal security/penetration/compliance needs may require specialist firms and cannot be safely collapsed into a generic reviewer task.
If customer acquisition is one-by-one founder education, this becomes a consultancy rather than a self-propelled routing system.
kill_conditions: Chinese builders consistently rely on automated review and show no willingness to pay for independent human judgment.
Existing domestic platforms already offer an equivalent fixed-scope small human review at acceptable price/turnaround.
Review scope cannot be standardized enough for reviewer substitution and consistent acceptance.
Most economically meaningful buyers require formal pentest/compliance/certification rather than this lighter review.
Demand acquisition requires founder-led sales for every review.
promotion_conditions: One named Chinese builder with a live/near-live AI-built product accepts a bounded paid review unit or provides a recent paid workaround.
At least two qualified reviewers accept the same task/report schema and payout logic.
The review can be completed without the operator doing core technical delivery.
A recurring demand pump can be bound: AI-coding community, tool ecosystem, incubator, training cohort, app-launch workflow or another channel that continually produces launch-ready projects.
The spread between payer price, reviewer payout and QA/tool cost leaves credible orchestration margin.

comparison_with_closed_patterns.why_not_generic_freelancing: The target unit is a standardized judgment/acceptance product, not open-ended developer labor.
comparison_with_closed_patterns.why_not_generic_security_audit: Scope is production-readiness triage for small AI-built apps; formal pentest/compliance remains a separate specialist escalation.
comparison_with_closed_patterns.why_operator_fit_is_higher: The operator can design evidence/task/acceptance/routing mechanics from software-engineering knowledge while delegating recurring technical review.

current_best_next_truth: Bind one real Chinese AI-app builder at the moment immediately before launch/real users and determine the actual current workaround, perceived downside, and willingness to pay for a fixed-scope independent human production-readiness review. In parallel bind at least two reviewers to the same report schema. Do not pitch/build before buyer payment truth.
